Appendix B Other Formulations for Lavg

abstract_sentences.text: Scalable sampling of molecular states in thermodynamic equilibrium is a long-standing challenge in statistical physics.

evidence.anchor: long-standing challenge in statistical physics

abstract_sentences.text: Boltzmann Generators tackle this problem by pairing a generative model, capable of exact likelihood computation, with importance sampling to obtain consistent samples under the target distribution.

evidence.anchor: pairing a generative model with importance sampling

abstract_sentences.text: Current Boltzmann Generators primarily use continuous normalizing flows (CNFs) trained with flow matching for efficient training of powerful models.

evidence.anchor: primarily use continuous normalizing flows

abstract_sentences.text: However, likelihood calculation for these models is extremely costly, requiring thousands of function evaluations per sample, severely limiting their adoption.

evidence.anchor: requiring thousands of function evaluations per sample

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we propose Few-step Accurate Likelihoods for Continuous Flows (FALCON), a method which allows for few-step sampling with a likelihood accurate enough for importance sampling applications by introducing a hybrid training objective that encourages invertibility.

evidence.anchor: hybrid training objective that encourages invertibility

abstract_sentences.text: We show FALCON outperforms state-of-the-art normalizing flow models for molecular Boltzmann sampling and is over two orders of magnitude faster than the equivalently performing CNF model.

evidence.anchor: over two orders of magnitude faster

abstract_sentences.text: FALCON code is available at https://github.com/danyalrehman/FALCON.

final_judgment.single_storyline: BG 的 SNIS 需要每个样本都能快速取得 proposal likelihood；FALCON 将 few-step average-velocity flow map 与前后向 cycle consistency 结合，再以 DiT 和 schedule 实现较大 peptide 上的速度/质量折中。证据：p.1–6。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 目标/BG/SNIS 接口、CNF 成本、Linv/hybrid loss、Proposition 1–2 摘要、Algorithm 1、三指标、Tables 2–5、Fig.2–7 以及 Limitations，足以判断速度—质量—正则折中。证据：p.3–10。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、Lavg 替代、DiT/optimizer/EMA、Dopri5/trace、schedule 方程、MCMC split、指标定义、reverse-map/NFE/Ramachandran 图移至 A–F；完整复现和 mode coverage 依赖附录。证据：p.16–25。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Eq.3 对照 Eq.8–9 转译 likelihood 成本为可逆性目标；Table 3 并列规模与 local/global metrics；Table 4 把 training+inference 作为系统成本；Fig.5–7 分别显示 steps、λr、schedule。证据：p.3–9。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 理论只在精确 minimizer/Linv→0 条件下闭合，缺少 finite-training likelihood 偏差界；ALDP Table 2 不支持“所有 metrics 都胜”的宽表述；Table 3 与 D.1 的分母冲突提高复现成本。证据：p.7、p.10、p.16–18。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 凡把可逆/可计算 likelihood 作为能力主张，必须同时报告形式条件、有限训练后的 reconstruction/Jacobian/likelihood error，以及相同 operating point 的速度—精度配对表。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有 inverse/likelihood 误差接口的生成论文；无此接口的任务应改报任务特定 estimand。FALCON 对 Bayesian inference 与 robotics 仅作 future work，未在本文验证。证据：p.10。
